implementation: Added an explicit OpenAI-compatible chat-completions HTTP transport with endpoint normalization, authorization only for managed/BYOK credentials, structured response parsing and usage extraction.

Connected Electron retrieval to the configured provider mode only after local ranking; the provider receives approved citation metadata/snippets and invalid, unavailable or cancelled requests retain an explicit source-only fallback.

Kept provider usage ledgers scoped by selected settings and exposed accumulated request/token/cost state through provider status without adding a billing service or embedding proxy secrets in the bundle.
Updated the renderer status text to distinguish model adjudication, explicit source-only fallback and no-provider local retrieval.

Main, preload, renderer and popout bundles compiled successfully.
173 tests passed with 941 expectations; structural, contract, matrix, accessibility, Knip and changed-file Fallow gates passed.

provider_boundary.scope: Local ranking selects citations before provider dispatch; excluded paths are not included in the prompt.
